# intro


```{r setup, results = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

## libraries ----

library(here)
library(data.table)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mfutils)
library(ggseg)
library(ggsegExtra)
library(ggsegSchaefer)
library(ggsegGlasser)

source(here("src", "stroop-rsa-pc.R"))

## settings, params ----

opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, out.width = "100%")
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 10))

theme_surface <- list(
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = c(0.5, 0.5), legend.title = element_text(size = 5), 
    legend.background = element_blank(), legend.text = element_text(size = 5), legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.height = unit(1/5, "cm"), legend.key.width = unit(1/4, "cm")
  )
)

colors_model <- c(
  target = "#1b9e77",
  incongruency = "#d95f02",
  distractor = "#7570b3"
)


## constants ----

subjlists <- combo_paste(sessions, "_", waves)
seswaves <- subjlists
glmname <- "lsall_1rpm"
measure <- "crcor"
prewh <- "none"
ttype_subsets <- c("pc50", "bias")
roisets <- c("glasser2016_parcel", "glasser2016_superparcel")


## data ----

## read regression weights:

dat <- enlist(combo_paste(roisets, ttype_subsets, subjlists))
for (roiset in roisets) {
  for (ttype_subset in ttype_subsets) {
    for (subjlist in subjlists) {
      fname <- construct_filename_weights(
          ttype_subset = ttype_subset,
          measure = measure, 
          subjlist = subjlist,
          glmname = glmname, 
          roiset = roiset,
          prewh = prewh, 
          suffix = paste0("__seswave-", subjlist),
          base_dir = here("out", "weights")
          )
        
      d <- fread(fname)
      d$ttype_subset <- ttype_subset
      d$roiset <- roiset
      dat[[paste0(roiset, ttype_subset, subjlist)]] <- d
    }
  }
}
dat <- rbindlist(dat)

## behavioral data (proactive session)

fit <- readRDS(here("out", "behav", "m1_ebm_gauss_het.RDS"))
beh <- data.table(
  subject = rownames(coef(fit)$subj),
  stroop = coef(fit)$subj[, "trial_typeincon"]
  )

dat <- dat %>% left_join(beh, by = "subject")


## for dat_parcel, get ggseg atlas and format data to match::
dat <- dat %>% rename(region = roi)
dat_parcel <- dat %>% filter(roiset == "glasser2016_parcel")
dat_superp <- dat %>% filter(roiset == "glasser2016_superparcel")
rm(dat)
atlas <- glasser
k <- glasser2016_fsaverage5$key %>% select(region = parcel, network)
dat_parcel <- dat_parcel %>% filter(!region %in% "L_10pp")  ## not in glasser ggseg atlas?
## create region column in ggseg atlas that matches data:
hemi <- ifelse(atlas$data$hemi == "left", "L_", "R_")
atlas$data$region <- ifelse(is.na(atlas$data$region), NA, paste0(hemi, atlas$data$region))
md <- list(
  core = c("p9-46v", "a9-46v", "i6-8", "AVI", "8C", "IFJp", "IP2", "IP1", "PFm", "8BM", "SCEF"),
  extended = c(
    "a9-46v", "p10p", "a10p", "11l", "a47r", "p47r", "FOP5", "AVI", "p9-46v", "8C", "IFJp", "6r", "s6-8", "i6-8",
    "SCEF", "8BM", "a32pr", "d32", "TE1m", "TE1p", "AIP", "IP2", "LIPd", "MIP", "IP1", "PGs", "PFm", "POS2"
  )
)
md <- lapply(md, function(x) combo_paste(c("L_", "R_"), x))
## add network information:
atlas$data <- left_join(atlas$data, k, by = "region")
dat_parcel <- left_join(dat_parcel, k, by = "region")


## subject lists ----

## jneuro sample (proactive wave1)
## replication sample (proactive wave1, unrelated to jneuro sample)
## retest sample (all wave 2 proactive)
## - handle twins via subsampling -> mean t value?

subjs_jneuro <- fread(here("out", "subjlist_jneurosci_primary.txt"))[[1]]
subjs_replic <- fread(here("out", "subjlist_jneurosci_replication_primary.txt"))[[1]]
subjs_replic_cotwin <- fread(here("out", "subjlist_jneurosci_replication_cotwin.txt"))[[1]]

```



# proactive session

## group

### jneuro

#### superparcels

```{r}

ses <- "proactive"

for (tty in ttype_subsets) {
  
  d <- dat_superp %>%
    filter(
      session == ses, wave == "wave1", ttype_subset == tty, !term %in% c("intercept", "conjunction"), 
      subject %in% subjs_jneuro
    )

  p <- d %>%

    ggplot(aes(region, b, color = term, fill = term)) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_boot, geom = "errorbar", position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), width = 0.25, size = 1) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 21, size = 4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +

    scale_fill_brewer(type = "qual", palette = 2) +
    scale_color_brewer(type = "qual", palette = 2) +

    labs(title = paste0(ses, " ", tty, " jneuro sample (", length(unique(d$subject)), ")"))

  print(p)

}

```

ses <- "proactive"

for (mod in c("target", "distractor", "incongruency")) {
  for (tty in ttype_subsets) {

      stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_boot, geom = "errorbar", position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), width = 0.25, size = 1) +

for (mod in c("target", "distractor", "incongruency")) {

      group_by(term, ttype_subset, wave, session, region) %>%
      filter(
        wave == "wave1", ttype_subset == tty, term == mod
      ) %>%

## calculate ----

## add subject set information:
#subjs <- fread(here("out", "subjlist_mc1_unrel.txt"))[[1]]
#dat <- dat %>% filter(subject %in% subjs)

dat_sum <- dat %>% 
  group_by(term, ttype_subset, wave, session, region) %>%
  summarize(
    m = mean(b),
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic, 
    p = t.test(b, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    .groups = "drop_last"
    ) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr"))

dat %>% 
  group_by(term, ttype_subset, wave, session, region) %>%
  summarize(
    m = mean(b),
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic, 
    p = t.test(b, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    .groups = "drop_last"
    ) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr"))

This file displays group-level RSA model coefficients (means, test statistics).

**Analysis parameters**:

- Item type: `r params$ttype_subset`
- Prewhitening type: `r params$prewh`
- Similarity measure: `r params$measure`
- ROI set: `r params$roiset`

**Subject samples**:

Analyses are conducted with one set of subjects:

- the **baseline wave 1**set: N = `r n_subjs`, unrelated


# Brains

## Unthresholded

### Common scale

```{r message = FALSE}

for (ttype in ttype_subsets) {

  for (model in models$crcor[-1]) {
    
    p <- dat_sum %>%
      filter(
        term == model, wave == "wave1", ttype_subset == ttype
        ) %>%
      ungroup %>%
      ggplot() +
      geom_brain(
        aes(fill = ifelse(t_stat > 2, t_stat, NA)),
        atlas = atlas, position = position_brain(. ~ side + hemi)
        ) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(
        option = "magma", na.value = "grey",
        breaks = scales::extended_breaks(4)
        ) +
      facet_grid(rows = vars(session)) +
      theme_surface +
      labs(title = paste0(model, " ", ttype))

    print(p)

  }

}

```

### Separate scales by model


```{r message = FALSE, fig.show = "hold", out.width = "50%"}

for (model_i in seq_along(models[[measure]])) {

  model <- models[[measure]][model_i]

  for (stat_i in seq_along(statistics)) {

    p <- dat_sum %>%
      filter(term %in% model) %>%
      ggplot() +
      geom_brain(
        aes_string(fill = statistics[stat_i]),
        atlas = atlas, position = position_brain(hemi + side ~ .)
        ) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(
        option = "magma", na.value = "grey",
        breaks = scales::extended_breaks(4)
        ) +
      facet_grid(cols = vars(ttype_subset)) +
      theme_surface +
      theme(legend.position = c(2/3, 0.5)) +
      labs(title = paste0(titles[stat_i], ": ", model), fill = NULL)

    print(p)

  }

}

```


## Thresholded

Three consecutive thresholds are used, each more liberal than the previous:

- **p_FDR < 0.05**: parcels with mean model fit significantly greater than 0 following FDR correction over all parcels (separately per model and trialtype set)
- **p_uncorr < 0.05**: parcels with mean model fit significantly greater than 0 (uncorrected)
- **t_stat > 0**: parcels with mean model fit numerically greater than zero

### Common scale

```{r message = FALSE}

dat_sum$is_in_thresh_fdr <- dat_sum$p_fdr < 0.05
dat_sum$is_in_thresh_p <- dat_sum$p < 0.05
dat_sum$is_in_thresh_sign <- dat_sum$t_stat > 0

thresholds <- c("p_fdr < 0.05", "p_uncorr < 0.05", "t_stat > 0")
thresholds_nms <- c("is_in_thresh_fdr", "is_in_thresh_p", "is_in_thresh_sign")

for (thresh_i in seq_along(thresholds)) {

  threshold_nm <- thresholds_nms[thresh_i]

  for (stat_i in seq_along(statistics)) {

    dat_sum$thresh <- as.numeric(ifelse(dat_sum[[threshold_nm]], dat_sum[[statistics[stat_i]]], NA))

    p <- dat_sum %>%
      ggplot() +
      geom_brain(
        aes(fill = thresh),
        atlas = atlas, position = position_brain(side ~ hemi)
        ) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(
        option = "magma", na.value = "grey",
        breaks = scales::extended_breaks(4)
        ) +
      facet_grid(rows = vars(term), cols = vars(ttype_subset)) +
      theme_surface +
      labs(title = paste0(titles[stat_i], ": thresholded at ", thresholds[thresh_i]), fill = NULL)

    print(p)

  }

}

```


# Tables


## Intersection: PC50 and bias

Parcels that are FDR-significant within both PC50 and bias stimulus sets.


### FDR corrected whole-cortex

```{r, results = "asis"}

sig_both <- dat_sum %>% 
  filter(p_fdr < 0.05, ttype_subset %in% c("bias", "pc50")) %>% 
  group_by(term, region) %>% 
  summarize(is_sig_both = n() == 2) %>%
  filter(is_sig_both)

d <- enlist(c("target", "distractor", "incongruency"))
for (model in names(d)) {

  d[[model]] <- dat_sum %>%
    ungroup %>%
    filter(term == model, region %in% sig_both$region[sig_both$term == model]) %>%
    select(region, m, t_stat, p) %>%
    arrange(region, ttype_subset)

}

lapply(d, kable)

```


### FDR corrected within ROIs

```{r, results = "asis"}

dat_sum_rois <- dat_sum %>% filter(region %in% rois$region) %>% mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr"))

sig_both_rois <- dat_sum_rois %>% 
  filter(p_fdr < 0.05, ttype_subset %in% c("bias", "pc50")) %>% 
  group_by(term, region) %>% 
  summarize(is_sig_both = n() == 2) %>%
  filter(is_sig_both)

d <- enlist(c("target", "distractor", "incongruency"))
for (model in names(d)) {
  
  d[[model]] <- dat_sum_rois %>% 
    ungroup %>%
    filter(term == model, region %in% sig_both$region[sig_both$term == model]) %>%
    select(region, ttype_subset, m, t_stat, p, p_fdr) %>%
    arrange(region, ttype_subset)
}

lapply(d, kable)

```


### P<0.05 uncorrected within ROIs

```{r, results = "asis"}

dat_sum_rois <- dat_sum %>% filter(region %in% rois$region) %>% mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr"))

sig_both_rois_uncorr <- dat_sum %>% 
  filter(region %in% rois$region, p < 0.05, ttype_subset %in% c("bias", "pc50")) %>% 
  group_by(term, region) %>% 
  summarize(is_sig_both = n() == 2) %>%
  filter(is_sig_both)

d <- enlist(c("target", "distractor", "incongruency"))
for (model in names(d)) {
  
  d[[model]] <- dat_sum_rois %>% 
    ungroup %>%
    filter(term == model, region %in% sig_both_rois_uncorr$region[sig_both_rois_uncorr$term == model]) %>%
    select(region, ttype_subset, m, t_stat, p, p_fdr) %>%
    arrange(region, ttype_subset)
}

lapply(d, kable)

```



# Bar plots

```{r, message = FALSE}
## prep for plotting:

dat_barplots <- dat %>% 
  mutate(
    term = factor(term, levels = c("target", "incongruency", "distractor")),
    region_nice = gsub("17Networks_", "", region)
    ) %>%
  filter(term %in% c("target", "distractor", "incongruency"))

dat_barplots <- dat_barplots %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "ttype_subset", values_from = "b") %>%
  mutate(b = pc50 - bias, ttype_subset = "pc50 - bias") %>%
  select(-pc50, -bias) %>%
  rbind(dat_barplots)

```
